title: Generation of murine sympathoadrenergic progenitor-like cells from embryonic stem cells
protocol: Cultivate the murine embryonic stem cell \(mESC) line D3 on mitotically inactivated primary mouse embryonic fibroblasts \(MEFs).
Place 75 drops of ES medium containing various numbers of ES cells onto the lids of 10 cm petri dishes filled with phosphate-buffered saline \(PBS).
Cultivate the ES cell-containing drops as hanging drops for 2 days.
Transfer EB aggregates from the hanging drops into 6 cm bacteriological petri dishes.
Further cultivate EB aggregates in suspension for 5 days.
Plate embryoid bodies generated from mESCs by the hanging drop method in Iscove’s Modified Dulbecco’s Medium containing 10% FCS on 0.1% gelatin-coated dishes.
Replace medium with Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium:Ham’s F-12 supplemented with insulin, transferrin, selenium, and fibronectin after 1 day of cultivation.
Culture cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 7 days to generate neural progenitor cells \(NPCs).
Enrich NCSCs from NPCs by CD57 expression sorting.
Plate dissociated NPCs on poly-D-lysine/fibronectin coated culture dishes.
Culture the cells in NCSC medium for 7 days in a hypoxia chamber adjusted to 3% oxygen.
Sort low-enriched NCSC-like population by FACS for expression of CD57 to generate higher-enriched NCSC-like cells.
Stain cells with GD2 antibody and sort them using FACS to generate highly-enriched SAP-like cells.
